race.comment: INDEFINITE (3) built on a nice second two starts back at Innisfail with success over 1400m at this track five weeks ago, getting home by a nose. Best figures measure up and is sure to run well. MUSKITO (7) showed good speed here last time over 1250m and led into the straight before tiring to finish ninth. Gets Wiggins on board and is expected to be in this for a long way. FISTSOFFURY (4) was below his best last time when seventh over 1200m at Townsville, beaten 2.75 lengths. Meets some better types this time but this looks well within his grasp. KHABALOV (1) did little and finished 7 lengths from the winner in 11th over 1609m at Townsville last start, a less impressive effort than his seventh at this track the run before. Finds a nice race and can figure in the finish.
